name: workspace
description: Bootstrap and manage multi-repo dev environments for AI-assisted development: clone repos from a domain, layer per-repo Claude context, track work in structured project workspaces, and see it all in a live pane with a task list, git guardrails and worktree tooling.

workspaceRoot.title: Workspace root
workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the workspace root; defaults to the session's project root.

statusLine.title: Show status line
statusLine.description: Pin a one-line workspace digest (repos, dirty, ahead/behind) under the prompt.

paneAutoOpen.title: Open pane at start
paneAutoOpen.description: Open the workspace pane automatically at session start.

guardrails.title: Guardrail posture
guardrails.description: How to react to a git command that looks like a mistake (push to the source remote, commit on a default branch).

autoSyncDoc.title: Auto-sync workspace doc
autoSyncDoc.description: Automatically write the managed workspace-map block into the root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md when it drifts, instead of only nudging.

docFile.title: Workspace doc file
docFile.description: Which root doc owns the managed workspace-map block.
